description: This PHP class, LeaveModuleStatusChangeSubscriber, is an event subscriber for handling module status change events within the OrangeHRM Dashboard. It listens for changes in the leave module and updates widget permissions accordingly.

classes.name: LeaveModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber class that listens for leave module status changes and updates dashboard widget permissions accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the module status change event.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handler method that executes when the module status change event is triggered, updating widget permissions if the leave module was previously active.
